sp500_direction: UP +1.0% to +1.8% if May CPI ≤ 3.5% YoY / DOWN -1.2% to -2.0% if CPI ≥ 3.9% — Wednesday's 8:30 AM ET CPI print is the sole dominant catalyst with Fed rate-hike odds at 72%, making this a binary-outcome day for equities.

stock_picks.thesis: Oracle reports earnings Wednesday evening; AI infrastructure sentiment is running hot and a cloud/AI revenue beat could trigger a gap-up as the market looks for the next post-Broadcom data center spending confirmation.

With S&P 500 inclusion effective June 22, passive index funds must mechanically accumulate MRVL shares over the next two weeks, making every pullback a high-probability buying opportunity driven by forced demand.

A CPI print at or below consensus 3.5% would trigger a sharp relief rally in long-duration Treasuries as rate-hike expectations compress rapidly, offering asymmetric upside for TLT holders going into the print.

The semiconductor sector's structural AI tailwind remains intact with 61% quarterly outperformance vs. the S&P 500, and two volatile days of selling have created an attractive re-entry point for a CPI-driven bounce in the SOXX ETF.

Iran's stated end to its military operation against Israel and Trump's diplomatic optimism signal a potential unwinding of the geopolitical oil risk premium, making the energy ETF a short candidate as crude prices normalize toward pre-escalation levels.
